ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IDR_Task', ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Status,'On hold'), OR( AND( ISNEW(), NOT(ISPICKVAL (Status,'Completed')), ISPICKVAL(Type,'Pend Case'), NOT(ISBLANK(Case__r.IDR_Date_Case_on_Hold_From__c ))), OR( AND(NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISCHANGED( ActivityDate ), ISCHANGED( WhatId ), ISCHANGED( Subject ), ISCHANGED(Description), ISCHANGED(Priority), ISCHANGED( Status ), AND(ISCHANGED( Type ), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Type),'Pend Case'))) ))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This case is already On Hold. If you have made an error or are trying to create a new On Hold task, please update the case status back to Escalated/Re-Opened, re-enter the correct details in these fields and place the case On Hold again.
